scope: Separate keyboard submission from voice review, editable voice review and simpler menus.

topics.title: Correct answers during voice form review
details: Say Change this field, Change field two or Change followed by a field name. Answer the guided correction question. Companion then builds a fresh review and submission signature. Saying No to submission leaves correction available.

topics.title: Compact radio keyboard actions
details: Selected or playing stations have seven keyboard actions: Add to favorites, Record current station, Schedule recording, Pause audio, Play, Stop recording and Cancel scheduled recordings. Play starts the selected station, or resumes it when the same station is already open. Scheduled recordings open as a list; Enter requests cancellation confirmation. Escape returns to broader station browsing. Legacy spoken commands and voice action menus remain available.

topics.title: Keyboard Send
details: Keyboard Enter or Space on a submit button activates the website button directly. It does not require spoken field review or Continue review. Voice activation retains guided review and explicit final confirmation.

topics.title: Main menu order
details: The shared keyboard and voice menu is Word processor, Notepad, Email, Web browser, Radio, Podcasts, Options, Check for updates, Help, Shut down the computer, Restart the computer and Exit Voice Companion. Exit appears once, at the end. What is new remains available as a direct command.

topics.title: Options names
details: Documents options is now Word processor options; Updates options is Auto-update options. A Notepad options category provides Open Notepad. Existing category voice names remain accepted as aliases.
